title: qgate configuration (qgate.config.json)
description: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for the frozen qgate configuration contract (docs/01-architecture.md §5.1, configSchemaVersion=1.0). additionalProperties is false everywhere: the field names, types, required-ness and enum values below are the frozen baseline and may not be added to, removed from or renamed.

version.description: configSchemaVersion. The only accepted value is the literal "1.0".

provider.description: Finding provider configuration. Required at the top level.

gates.description: Required, length >= 1. gate.id must be globally unique and check.id unique within its gate; both uniqueness rules are enforced by the engine, not by JSON Schema.

projectRoot.description: Optional. Relative path from the configuration file to the repository it validates; the engine resolves it against the config directory. Used when the config sits next to (not inside) its target repository, e.g. demo/qgate.config.json declaring "projectRoot": "mini-service". Takes precedence over inferRootFromConfig.

selection.description: Optional. Defaults to {}. Deterministic file-selection settings (OCR selection parity).

grouping.description: Optional. Defaults to {}. Deterministic FileGroup settings.

gateId.description: Frozen id pattern shared by gate.id and check.id.

relativePath.description: Project-root-relative POSIX path; may contain * or ** when the check documents glob support.

type.description: provider.type — four frozen values. deterministic is the offline-fixture default.

script.description: Required when provider.type="scripted"; must export run(context).

model.description: Only meaningful when provider.type="llm"; a real LLM is optional and never required.

endpoint.description: Only meaningful when provider.type="llm"; must degrade to deterministic when unreachable (no network is required).

fixture.description: Provider fixture path. The deterministic provider reads its recordings from here; null means the built-in offline fixture path (provider.mjs DEFAULT_FIXTURE_PATH).

confidenceThreshold.description: Findings at or above this confidence become blockers; lower-confidence findings are downgraded to advisory findings.

scanRoots.description: Narrows which subtrees the policy checks scan (SAFE_001 key tokens, SAFE_003 network surface). null or an empty array scans the whole repository.

selectionSettings.description: Deterministic file selection, mirroring the OCR selection pipeline. Every field is optional and has an engine default.

exclude.description: Exclude globs applied after include. Default [].

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Files larger than this are excluded. Default 262144.

maxFilesPerGroup.description: Grouping cap mirror; the grouping object carries the operative value. Default 10.

ruleFile.description: OCR rule file used for deterministic rule matching, e.g. ".opencodereview/rule.json". Default null.

groupingSettings.description: Deterministic FileGroup settings. maxFilesPerGroup is capped at 10 by the OCR parity contract when the token budget allows; exceeding the budget downgrades a group to single-file groups.

maxFilesPerGroup.description: Files per group. Default 10 (the frozen OCR value).

tokensPerFile.description: Estimated tokens per file used for the budget check. Default 4.

humanGate.description: Only allowed on gates whose stage is one of the three frozen handover positions (requirements -> req-to-design, design -> design-to-build, review -> review-to-verify). Any other stage is a configuration error (exit code 2). The handover identity is DERIVED from the gate's stage; gate.id need not equal the handover id. The optional gateId property explicitly overrides that derivation. role must match the handover position (requirements->product, design->architect, review->reviewer).

role.description: Signing role; must match the handover position and approval.json.role.

gateId.description: Optional explicit override of the handover id. When omitted, the handover id is DERIVED from the gate's stage (requirements -> req-to-design, design -> design-to-build, review -> review-to-verify). When present it must satisfy the shared gate id pattern and, per the engine, be one of the three handover ids. It also determines the <gateId> segment of the default approvalRecord path.

approvalRecord.description: Optional; defaults to verification/approvals/<gateId>/approval.json, where <gateId> is the explicit humanGate.gateId when given, otherwise the handover id derived from the gate's stage.

stage.description: One of the five frozen stages (§3.1).

required.description: false means a failure is recorded but does not block overall_passed.

check.description: Discriminated union on check.type. Shared fields plus the per-type field table of §5.1; additionalProperties is false so an unknown field name is rejected.

checkBase.$comment: Shared field table of §5.1. additionalProperties is intentionally true here because JSON Schema evaluates it per subschema: the seven type variants below each declare the complete field set (shared + per-type) with additionalProperties:false, which is what actually rejects an undeclared field name.

type.description: check.type — the seven frozen check types.

severity.description: Defaults per type: file_exists/file_not_exists/json_assert/trace_matrix/policy => high; regex => medium; command => high.

onFail.description: warn records the real pass/fail result but never adds a blocker.

file.description: Any glob match fails the check.

run.description: argv vector; run[0] is the executable name. No shell is involved.

captureStdout.description: Captures output into evidence.excerpt, clipped to 4096 characters.

stdoutRegex.description: Optional; when set, stdout must also match.

file.description: A single JSON file; globs are not supported.

jsonAssertion.description: At least one of exists|equals|matches must be present; the engine enforces that, and each carries evidence.

matches.description: Regular expression applied to the stringified value.

enforce.description: strict => a P0/P1 requirement with covered=false fails the check (TRACE_GAP).

policyId.description: SAFE_001 no key reads; SAFE_002 secret paths can never be re-included; SAFE_003 no network call surface; CONTRACT_001 no enum/field drift.

expectedFiles.description: Restricts the policy scan to this explicit file list (at most the first five are recorded as evidence); null scans per policy.scanRoots. When non-empty it replaces the subtree scan for this check.
